glosses: envelope (i.e. any natural covering), sheath (a structure covering an animal or plant organ)

examples.en: We were walking on the deck.

examples.text: Sus manos estaban cubiertas con lodo.
examples.en: His hands were covered with mud.

examples.text: La habitación está cubierta de polvo.
examples.en: The room is covered with dust.

examples.text: Las paredes están cubiertas de sangre.
examples.en: The walls are covered with blood.

examples.text: La máquina estaba cubierta de polvo.
examples.en: The machine was coated with dust.
